raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Update the GB200 AgentX presets of MiniMax-M3.1-Flash (`gb200_agentx_agg`, `gb200_agentx_pd`) to the Dynamo + vLLM lanes of [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#4632](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4632) (head `93621314`). Only touches `recipes/models/MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash.yaml`.

- **Frontend:** `DYN_TOKENIZER=fastokens` (Dynamo's fastokens tokenizer backend). Frontend tokenization of 100K+ token prompts drops from about 150 ms to about 1 ms per request, which comes straight off TTFT.
- **Mooncake pool:** 150 GB to 190 GB per rank. Run etcd, NATS, the Mooncake master and the frontend on a host without engine workers, so the trays' host DRAM goes to the pool.
- **Prefill:** `--gpu-memory-utilization` 0.88 to 0.92. **Decode:** drop `VLLM_MAX_ASYNC_KV_ADMITS_PER_STEP`, which had no measurable effect.
- **Measured points:** adds 2 prefill + DEP8 (224, 256 sessions), 3 prefill + DEP8 at 288, and 3 prefill + DEP16 at 320 and 360. The table, tuning rules and source revision are updated.

## Validation

- Measured in the lane's sweep ([run 41084082993](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/41084082993)): 2 prefill + DEP8 at 224/256 sessions: 94.2k/98.8k tok/s/GPU at 250/244 tok/s/user; 3 prefill + DEP8 at 288: 93.2k at 230; 3 prefill + DEP16 at 280/320/360: 70.4k/77.3k/85.4k at 302/291/284; 4 prefill + DEP16 at 352: 74.5k at 284. TTFT p90 is 1.8-5.3 s across the points.
- The file parses as YAML; `git diff --check` is clean.

KV moves from prefill to decode over NIXL (UCX over RDMA), and every rank contributes host DRAM to a shared Mooncake KV store, so a returning conversation's prefix is loaded from the store instead of recomputed. Both roles use expert parallelism with DeepGEMM MegaMoE, attention data parallelism, the V2 model runner and the seven-token DSpark draft on `FLASHINFER_TS`.

-      - **Prefill pool.** The prefill pool sets TTFT, so scale prefill workers with load. The lane's points kept TTFT p90 between 2.6 and 4.4 s with one DEP4 prefill tray per 85-95 concurrent agentic sessions (3 trays at 256-280 sessions, 4 at 352). -      - **DEP8 or DEP16 decode.** DEP8 gives the most tokens per GPU: 32 sessions per decode GPU at 244 tok/s/user. The decode graph cap is `--max-num-seqs` x (1 + 7 draft tokens) = 512. `--watermark 0.05` keeps 5% of the decode KV cache free, so extra requests wait in the queue instead of preempting running ones. Keep decode `--max-num-batched-tokens` at 8192: a preempted request recomputes its context in chunks of that size.
-      - **Prefill batching.** `--long-prefill-token-threshold 4096` chunks long prompts into 4096-token pieces. Short prompts then share each step with them instead of waiting behind a 100K-token context, which lowers the TTFT tail. The recipe's 1P1D section above uses 8192. `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384` bounds a prefill step. Prefill captures CUDA graphs up to 2048 tokens.
-      - **Mooncake pool size.** `global_segment_size` is registered by every DP rank, prefill and decode alike, so a tray pins four times that value. The lane used 150 GB per rank (600 GB per tray). Size it as (host DRAM free per tray after the engines are up - headroom for NIXL and the 4 GB local buffers) / ranks per tray. The decode ranks only add capacity to the pool (`kv_consumer` with `enable_lookup: false` and `save_decode_cache: false`): the prefill workers write and read every block.
+      - **Prefill pool.** The prefill pool sets TTFT, so scale prefill workers with load. The lane's points kept TTFT p90 between 1.8 and 5.3 s with one DEP4 prefill tray per 85-128 concurrent agentic sessions (2 trays at 224-256 sessions, 3 at 256-360, 4 at 352). Two prefill trays per DEP8 decode give the most tokens per GPU; a third keeps TTFT p90 near 3.5 s up to 288 sessions. Add a prefill tray when TTFT p90 climbs while decode still has room.
+      - **DEP8 or DEP16 decode.** DEP8 gives the most tokens per GPU: 28-36 sessions per decode GPU at 230-250 tok/s/user. DEP16 halves the batch per rank and gives about 25% more tok/s/user (302 at 280 sessions) and holds E2E latency p90 near 10 s up to 360 sessions, at about 10-20% fewer tokens per GPU. `--max-num-seqs 64` per DP rank is a cap, not the operating point. Keep decode `--max-num-batched-tokens` at 8192: a preempted request recomputes its context in chunks of that size.
+      - **Prefill batching.** `--long-prefill-token-threshold 4096` chunks long prompts into 4096-token pieces. Short prompts then share each step with them instead of waiting behind a 100K-token context, which lowers the TTFT tail. The recipe's 1P1D section above uses 8192. `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384` bounds a prefill step. Prefill captures CUDA graphs up to 2048 tokens. Prefill runs at `--gpu-memory-utilization 0.92`, decode at 0.88.
+      - **Mooncake pool size.** `global_segment_size` is registered by every DP rank, prefill and decode alike, so a tray pins four times that value. The lane used 190 GB per rank (760 GB per tray), which lets three DEP4 prefill trays serve up to 288 sessions with DEP8 and 360 with DEP16; 210 GB per rank ran the prefill trays out of host memory. Size it as (host DRAM free per tray after the engines are up - headroom for NIXL and the 4 GB local buffers) / ranks per tray. The Mooncake store catches the prefixes that miss after a reroute.
-      - **Transport.** Cross-tray NIXL needs `UCX_TLS=rc,cuda_copy` with `UCX_NET_DEVICES` set to the tray's RDMA ports. Without them, UCX can fall back to TCP and transfers stall. Point `UCX_MODULE_DIR` at the UCX bundled with the NIXL wheel (`nixl_cu13.libs/ucx` in the image's `dist-packages`). `kv_lease_duration: 120` holds a prefill's blocks for up to 120 s until decode reads them (the default is 30 s). `VLLM_MAX_ASYNC_KV_ADMITS_PER_STEP=4` caps how many requests with finished KV loads decode admits per step.
